```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
CAP <- sprintf(
  CAP,
  .requireOneTarget(.currentTarget("siteID.target"), "siteID.target", "SRS table caption")
)
if (!exists("PathSRS", inherits = FALSE)) {
  PathSRS <- .srsPath(root, target = if (exists("SRS.target", inherits = FALSE)) SRS.target)
  if (!exists("SRS.target", inherits = FALSE)) SRS.target <- basename(PathSRS)
}
```

source(file.path(root, "scripts", "tbl", "SRS.R"))
TBL
